Callout.Name: Protected Person - Diplomatic Escort
Callout.Message: Escort required for a protected diplomatic visit.
Callout.Advisory: Route has been used before, no specific threat.

Script.Line: Two cars, four minutes apart, and nobody stops.
If somebody blocks us we go around. We do not stop.
My passenger does not speak to anybody. That includes you.

Lines.Approach: Two cars and a clear route. If it goes wrong it goes wrong quickly.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
